tujuan.pengantar: Setelah mempelajari materi ini, peserta mampu:

blok.teks: A city councilor argues that extending library hours will improve examination results. She points to a survey in which 70% of respondents said they would use the library more often if it remained open later. The survey included 200 students from one nearby university. Critics observe that intentions to visit do not measure actual study time or examination performance. They also note that students who expressed interest in longer hours may already be more motivated. The councilor proposes a six-month trial, but no plan for comparing grades or tracking evening attendance has yet been announced.

The councilor emphasized that a quiet place to study could be especially useful to students whose homes were crowded. That reasoning offers a plausible explanation for why longer opening hours might help some learners. However, the survey did not ask respondents whether they would actually attend in the evening or whether they had alternative study spaces.

Several university representatives proposed a pilot evaluation that would record evening attendance and compare academic outcomes over time, while taking account of other study support offered during the trial. Without such information, higher interest in the library would not demonstrate that the policy itself improved examination performance.

soal.teks: How many students are included in the survey from one nearby university? Answer with numbers only.

pembahasan.teks: Pada materi Evaluating Opinions and Arguments, angka 200 menyatakan ukuran sampel survei yang digunakan untuk mendukung klaim anggota dewan kota. Angka tersebut tidak boleh tertukar dengan 70%, yang menunjukkan persentase responden berminat memakai perpustakaan lebih sering. Rumpang berada pada kalimat yang secara eksplisit menyebut jumlah peserta survei, sehingga hanya 200 yang benar.

soal.teks: Which additional evidence would most strengthen the councilor's claim?

opsi.A: The survey shows interest among students who already use the library regularly.
opsi.B: Library staff report that many students value quieter study environments.
opsi.C: Promotional messages increase students' awareness of the revised opening hours.
opsi.D: Comparable students show stronger examination results after receiving extended access.
opsi.E: More academic materials are borrowed during the library's original daytime schedule.

pembahasan.teks: Pertanyaan meminta bukti tambahan yang paling memperkuat klaim sebab-akibat bahwa perpanjangan jam perpustakaan meningkatkan nilai ujian. Survei awal hanya menunjukkan minat berkunjung, bukan perubahan hasil akademik. Opsi D benar karena membandingkan hasil ujian kelompok siswa yang sebanding setelah memperoleh akses yang diperpanjang. Dalam Evaluating Opinions and Arguments, strengthening evidence harus relevan terhadap outcome yang diklaim serta membantu memisahkan penjelasan alternatif seperti motivasi belajar.
A salah karena minat menggunakan perpustakaan tidak menunjukkan peningkatan nilai.
B salah karena komentar mengenai suasana nyaman tidak mengukur hasil ujian.
C salah karena pengetahuan tentang kebijakan tidak membuktikan dampak terhadap prestasi.
E salah karena jumlah peminjaman sebelum kebijakan bukan bukti efektivitas jam tambahan.

soal.teks: Determine whether each statement is true or false according to the passage.

baris: The study population includes every university student in the city.
The survey measures intended library use rather than exam scores.
The proposed trial already includes a controlled assessment of grades.
Motivation could be an alternative explanation for later performance differences.

pembahasan.teks: Soal ini meminta peserta mengategorikan empat pernyataan sebagai Benar atau Salah berdasarkan stimulus. Dalam materi Evaluating Opinions and Arguments, penilaian dilakukan dengan membandingkan cakupan setiap pernyataan dengan fakta, hubungan informasi, dan batasan yang dinyatakan dalam bacaan.
Pernyataan 1 (Salah): hanya 200 mahasiswa dari satu universitas.
Pernyataan 2 (Benar): responden ditanya apakah akan lebih sering datang.
Pernyataan 3 (Salah): rencana pengukuran itu belum diumumkan.
Pernyataan 4 (Benar): mahasiswa yang berminat mungkin sudah lebih termotivasi.
